newsitem.title: USA: Redwood to acquire Olivia, Minn., bank.
newsitem.headline: Redwood to acquire Olivia, Minn., bank.

text.p: Redwood Financial Inc said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Olivia Bancorp Inc for about $4.38 million cash.
Olivia owns 97.6 percent of the outstanding stock of American State Bank of Olivia, Minn., Redwood said.
The proposed deal will be accounted for as a purchase, it said.
American State Bank has assets of $28.9 million. Redwood has assets of $51 million.
If a definitive merger agreement has not been executed within 45 days of the letter of intent, the agreement will terminate, the company said.
The transaction requires federal and state regulatory approval and completion of a due diligence by Redwood.

Olivia and American State Bank have agreed not to enter into discussions or negotiations with any third parties regarding the sale of Olivia and/or American State Bank or any of their assets, Redwood said.
